title: Something Catchy For Coffee
tests: Tests autonomous caption writing and attractive photo typography when the user delegates the wording.

judge.summary: The square latte photo gains a warm, readable caption, “A little cup of cozy,” while keeping the coffee and leaf fully visible.

must_haves.item: The supplied top-down latte photograph remains the base of the square output.
must_haves.why: The same cup, saucer, leaf, marble table, and background remain in the square composition, with a warmer color treatment.

must_haves.item: A short, coherent English caption is visibly added to the picture, rather than supplied only in chat.
must_haves.why: “A little cup of cozy” appears clearly across two lines above the cup.

must_haves.item: The caption has a warm coffee-related tone and is readable against the background.
must_haves.why: The cozy cup wording suits the latte, and the large dark lettering contrasts well with the pale tabletop.

must_haves.item: The latte and its leaf-shaped foam art remain visible and unobscured by the lettering.
must_haves.why: The lettering stays above the cup without covering the coffee, foam, or central leaf.

must_haves.item: No logo, price, discount, or other sales information is added.
must_haves.why: Only the short caption is added; no branding or promotional information is visible.
